ops.title: Vault migration arc: metal→vault (Linux creds container) + corten/tuwunel iMessage + retire last macOS guests
ops.description:
Approved plan (2026-07-18): `/Users/yasyf/.cc-pool/accounts/acct-12/plans/now-that-metal-is-tingly-planet.md` (design record alongside it; absorbs acct-16 `we-were-going-to-tranquil-metcalfe.md`). Amended decision note: 91cb1b5f.

Phases: P0 prep (ACL tag:vault, secrets-manifest hosts.vault, imsg-extract-key.sh, user key extraction as the yclaw Apple ID) → G1 corten gate (parallel lane, blocks P7+) → P1 code (vault image + wiring + prepared hermes flip) → P2 build → P3 stage/bring-up/acceptance (state COPY under quiesce; CA byte-equal; DIRECT-not-DERP) → P4 flip (hermes image rebuild) → P5 soak (≥1 reboot) → P6 park metal → P7 corten+tuwunel onto vault → P8 hermes Matrix repoint + E2E → P9 renewal soak → P10 purge metal AND bluebubbles + docs.

Multi-day arc (soaks); any session resuming this should read the plan file first. Session-local task list mirrors these phases.

ops.text: vault (Linux container) serves agent-vault/cliproxy/relays with hermes flipped to it; metal parked then deleted
corten+tuwunel live on vault; hermes on the Matrix adapter; iMessage E2E incl. tapbacks both ways passes
machines.json has no metal and no bluebubbles; repo grep for both names clean outside CHANGELOG; pytest green; doctor green
